about: Tier 2 trigger sets: for each user-facing skill, prompts that should load it and realistic near-misses that should not. Source of truth for evals/trigger/**; regenerate with `node evals/tools/generate.js`.

start.fires: The reply moves the request into the Software Factory: it loads the factory driver and starts its loop (for example says it will run `factory doctor` / `factory next`, or restates the intent and proposes a work type and risk for a new job) instead of editing code directly.
